features.quote: Diaphragm 12 will make continuous contact around its entire outer edge with the article to be lifted out and act as a seal to preserve the vacuum created as and when diaphragm 12 is extended.
features.note: The quote describes the diaphragm acting as a seal around its outer edge to preserve vacuum, which is the function of a flexible sealing lip.
